notes:
Lead: FlowPilot (mid-market product onboarding SaaS). Evaluating Redwood Hosted API as step 1 for a fast POC (in-app onboarding copilot). Goal: conversational guided flows that run inside product with streaming responses, tool calling (open links, product state reads), consistent latency and token-cost caps.

Key ask from PM - 'we need predictable interactive latency for first-turn streaming and tool calls; token costs must be capped per session.' Emphasis on deterministic tail latency (95p < 800ms for interactive tokens) and streaming start <200ms preferred. They want server-side token budget control + client-visible budget signals.

Architecture notes: single-tenant mid-market instance initially on Hosted API, later committed Dedicated if latency and cost profile acceptable. POC to run synthetic workloads (50 concurrent users, avg 5 messages/session, peak 120 qps) and real-data closed beta with 200 users. POC scope: evaluate streaming quality, tool_call reliability (product state fetch + send events), prefix/KV caching to reduce upstream token spend.

Security/compliance: require SSO (SAML) integration, audit logs for user events, customer-managed KMS for keys is desirable. Data residency not strict now but want option for EU region.

Pricing/procurement: pricing sensitivity high. Willing to commit to Dedicated if unit economics beat Hosted after batching/caching optimizations. Finance asked for a 12-month committed quote and break-even with estimated ARR range.

Sales notes / quotes from calls: "We want the copilot to feel instantaneous — if it stutters users drop off." — PM Maria. SE notes: demo showed streaming + tool calling flow; FlowPilot asked for latency p95s and a test harness to reproduce in-house.

POC deliverables: Redwood to provide temporary sandbox keys, recommended batching/caching config, sample configs for token caps and streaming TTLs, and a baseline pricing estimate for Dedicated. FlowPilot will provide sample product-state APIs for tool-calling integration and a small dataset of onboarding scripts for eval.
timeline_activities: 2025-01-20: Intro call (AE + PM) — initial discovery, use-case overview
2025-01-27: Demo — Redwood hosted streaming + tool calling shown (sample copilot flow)
2025-02-03: SE call with FlowPilot engineers — discussed caching, session token caps, metrics to collect
2025-02-05: POC kickoff — Redwood sandbox keys issued, test harness plan agreed
2025-02-07: Security questionnaire submitted by FlowPilot (SOC2 + SAML questions)
2025-02-10: Pricing review call — FlowPilot requested committed Dedicated pricing and baseline Hosted cost for 6k monthly active users
next_step: Deliver POC report + baseline Hosted vs Dedicated cost model by 2025-02-18. Schedule week-of-2025-02-24 demo with beta product team to validate p95 latency and token cap enforcement.
blockers: Need sample p95 latency numbers on comparable workloads
Finance needs committed Dedicated quote to greenlight procurement
Need reproducible test harness to validate streaming tail latency
